Francis Foster and Konstantin Kisin, the comics behind the Triggernometry show, join Joe Rogan for episode 2398. Their London-based podcast hosts free-speech debates with guests across the spectrum. Both men mix stand-up roots with serious worry about the future of the West.

The pair discuss censorship, cultural decline, and why comedians became front-line voices for open speech. Kisin brings his Soviet-born view of how societies slide into control. Rogan compares the British and American scenes for comedy and dissent. Listeners who value open debate and liberty get two comics who are deadly serious about protecting it.
